programme.title: David Blaine: Do Not Attempt
programme.desc: American illusionist David Blaine gained international fame thanks to his unique combination of magic tricks and stunts.During his shows, he often took huge risks, for example allowing himself to be buried alive for seven days or spending several dozen hours in a huge block of ice.In the latest documentary series, the daredevil continues his adventure.I am looking for extraordinary people who redefine the boundaries of what is real.He visits six distant corners of the globe.Impossible?Yet!Swallowing swords, resistance to the venom of deadly reptiles and extreme cold, or athletic feats that break the laws of physics - these are just some of the challenges that are the main theme of individual episodes of the series.Blaine's escapades include: Brazil, Southeast Asia, India, the Arctic Circle, Africa and Japan.The traveler introduces viewers to different traditions and rituals.Before their eyes, he tries to master unique skills.In the finale of each episode, he tries to use the acquired knowledge in practice and do something seemingly impossible.In Brazil, he meets artists, explorers and athletes.They will join forces to help him achieve a feat he has been thinking about for a long time.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of The Maya
programme.desc: Albert Lin spent many months in the Guatemalan jungle in the company of an international team of scientists.He recorded material at twelve major archaeological sites.The researchers had at their disposal a LiDAR device that works similarly to an X-ray.It allowed the terrain to be scanned from the air.Thanks to this, a digital map was developed.A special application was also created showing the local landscape without forests.Therefore, there was no need to cut down the trees.Objects that were part of previously unknown cities were found, including pyramids and a fortified citadel.They also found the queen's skeleton, the ruler's burial chamber with richly decorated ritual vessels, fragments of the skull of a sacrificed child, bas-reliefs, a stone altar, a painted vase, as well as dozens of statuettes and ceramic objects.The discoveries made allowed us to re-evaluate the current knowledge about the Mayan civilization.
